facts.title: ANTEN DANSI
facts.text: Uzun antenlerini sallayarak balıklara temizliğe hazır olduğunu duyurur.

facts.title: CANLI TEMİZLİKÇİ
facts.text: Balıkların üzerindeki parazit, mantar ve hasarlı dokuyu pençeleriyle temizler.

facts.title: KİMYASAL ALGI
facts.text: Kendi türünden bireyleri kimyasal sinyallerle fark edebilir.

en.title: This Shrimp Dances to Call Fish Customers. Name It?
en.description: The banded coral shrimp waves its long white antennae and dances to advertise cleaning services to passing fish, removing parasites, fungi and damaged tissue. It can also detect others of its species, likely through chemical signals.
